prompt:
Create a universal, reusable ice material shader for Unity using Shader Graph.

This shader must NOT generate, model or modify any castle, building, environment or mesh.

It must only create a material that can be assigned to any existing 3D object and make that object appear physically made of ice.

The material must work consistently on all kinds of meshes, including:

- Buildings
- Walls
- Floors
- Stairs
- Columns
- Trees
- Branches
- Rocks
- Cliffs
- Furniture
- Chairs
- Tables
- Doors
- Props
- Statues
- Creatures
- Vehicles
- Weapons
- Organic meshes
- Hard-surface meshes
- Small objects
- Large objects
- Simple meshes
- Highly detailed meshes

The shader must preserve the original geometry and silhouette of the object.

It must automatically adapt to:
- Different mesh shapes
- Different object orientations
- Different object sizes
- Curved surfaces
- Sharp edges
- Concave and convex forms
- Thin and thick parts
- Camera movement
- Different lighting conditio
